cohorts.name: Cohort 1
cohorts.description: Our founding cohort of Data Diplomats who launched DSSG NYC and established its mission of civic tech for social good.

members.name: Jian
members.bio: A passionate advocate for data science driving social change, with research in Computational Social Sciences at the Max-Planck Institute. Interested in open-source intelligence and AI agentic systems. Brings community organizing training and years in big data to social good and civic tech.
members.motivation: Trained as a community organizer in university, was a computational researcher for Max Planck Institute of Geoanthropology, loves to write about economic history on substack.

members.name: Ursula
members.bio: Ursula is a Brooklyn-based data scientist leading DSSG NYC's nonprofit engagement, researching voter engagement, economic development, and public infrastructure. She began as a lawyer in open data policy, then spent three years on civic projects in Tbilisi, Georgia.
members.motivation: She started as a lawyer working on open data policy and spent three years on civic projects in Tbilisi, Georgia.

members.name: Carina
members.bio: Carina is a data professional with a Master's in Data Science and a dual Bachelor's in Quantitative Economics and Fine Arts from Tufts University. She volunteers with nonprofits in the data and civic tech space, drawn to the intersections between data, art, and community.
members.motivation: She studied data science and analytics, passionate about women’s education. In her spare time, she loves to make art and volunteer for her community.

cohorts.name: Cohort 2
cohorts.description: Our second cohort of Data Diplomats — engineers, researchers, and strategists who stepped up to lead nonprofit partners through data science, AI, and civic tech projects.

members.name: Aarya
members.bio: AI systems & compliance automation, trading terminals, national-scale ed-tech verification platforms (Mexico), IEEE SCET chair — 30+ initiatives, technical talent development, nonprofit data challenges.
members.motivation: He has built verification systems for the Department of Education in Mexico, passionate about health for all and spearheads our Fundraising AI project.

members.name: Mia
members.bio: PhD Social Psychology, mission-driven org research, Senior Research Director at NewWorld — nonprofit & philanthropy campaign studies, merger-era team leadership, adjunct professor of graduate statistics, data-to-strategy translation.
members.motivation: She is a part-time professor and a data driven social psychologist who spent years putting the analytical rigor into research, testing, and social sciences.

members.name: Franklin
members.bio: Computer vision engineering, worked in ocean carbon sequestration (Running Tide), Breathily co-founder — RGB-D lung-function testing for ALS, interested in mental health tech and democracy tech, published research at UCSF & UC Berkeley, Founder of FOIA-FLUENT.
members.motivation: He has aimed computer vision at ocean carbon removal and at lung-function testing for ALS patients. He founded FOIA-Fluent on the same instinct: the public record should be legible to the people it is actually about.

members.name: Tony
members.bio: Customer Success Manager, Workday nonprofit accounts, enterprise adoption for mission-driven orgs, NYC Parks volunteer event organizer, leads the Nonprofit Success Portal and Agentic Onboarding Design.
members.motivation: He currently is our pro bono client success lead and works as customer success manager for nonprofits at a tech firm, leveraging his love for social entrepreneurship.
